name: Spotlight Beams
description: Two fans of light from the upper corners that sway slowly toward each other and back.

props.name: colors
props.description: Colours of the left and right fans. Each fan has a pale core mixed toward snow white at night and toward ink by day.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one full sway, in and back out.

props.name: spread
props.description: How far each fan travels sideways during a sway, in pixels.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of each fan where it fades out, in pixels.

props.name: height
props.description: Length of each fan from its corner to where it fades out, in pixels.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the beams. Other div props are passed through.
